release_notes: Built from the newest source on main desktop DESKTOP-EE8BGVF, based on previously published 1.3.9 runtime.
Updated UI index.html, app.js, style.css, and matching web-server API from the main installation.
Integrated write-video-scene-prompts nine-field planning skill and episode continuity.
Balanced CPU/GPU rendering with NVENC capability detection and CPU fallback.
Preserved packaged Muse CLI, Flow MCP V2, authentication engines and runtime. No direct provider logic edits.
User credentials, accounts, cookies, productions and local state are not taken from the main machine.
Installer is an update ZIP for the existing one-click updater, not a new EXE build.
